about: The highest word error rate check.py lets each model score: its rate on a real run, plus 0.15 (three words of the sample sentence), rounded up to 0.05. Most misses are on Kyutai, TTS and CPU. A model that drops a sentence or babbles scores far above these. When a change makes one better, lower its ceiling.
measured: x86-64 2026-10-24 and arm64 CI, seed 1, Whisper small int8
